svg.title: Carrier pad wiring
svg.desc: Photo of the back of the XIAO 1.14 inch display carrier, USB-C up. Each pad sits just above its printed name. Right column: the GND pad above D11 goes to the Line 0 GND, D11 (GPIO38) to DATA in, D12 (GPIO39) to CLOCK in. U1, U2 and U3 each go through a 1 kilohm resistor to external buttons A, B and C, whose other sides go to the left-column GND pad. USB-C takes power from the power bank. The Grove connector is the IMU's I2C bus at 3.3 V, for sensors only.
